cost_and_reporting.reuse: Show one-shot and predeclared reuse-count totals/break-even separately; never make donor mining/training or per-query grounding free. Retain prior infrastructure failures separately from mathematical/search failures. No retrospective cap reset.
cost_and_reporting.scope_flags: Logical proof, original-Gamma sequent, current point union, actual selected origin, compatible-proposed origin, fullboard, native, full trajectory, quantified-profile, induction/PA, inventory admission and RL/performance claims remain separate. Unsupported native/fullboard/universal flags stay false.
cost_and_reporting.statistics: A tiny cohort can demonstrate effect or falsify utility on its exact scope; it cannot establish broad superiority. Report every paired raw outcome, completion/censoring reason, provenance and total cost, not only successful seeds or median successful time.
cost_and_reporting.unit: Sum genuine enclosing caller lifetimes for separate preparation/discovery/mining/admission/control/training/replay/query stages. Inner and owned subclocks are overlapping diagnostics, not additive costs. Include failed/incomplete/unexecuted work and cold input/cache/setup/grounding/serialization/cleanup; model/weight reuse is predeclared.

expressiveness_vs_evidence.automatic_discovery: A target is discovered only by an authorized unsupplied search, with the declared original context and independent primitive/point/current-state/resource acceptance. A target mark on an empty row, a pending selected output, an authored calibration word or extracted old certificate is not a newly discovered target.
expressiveness_vs_evidence.finite_compilation: A complete finite formula/recipe/row domain admission certifies the declared bounded language and its point encoding. It does not prove the target, infinite-plane tiling, a universal proof-checker tile set, or useful search. Configured finite Wang/compiler relation tests remain a different evidence axis.
expressiveness_vs_evidence.formal_first_order: Common ASTs, capture-safe substitution and freshness-sensitive primitive rules establish declared representation/checking scope, not automatic discovery, full first-order search completeness or unrestricted PA. Current Q has primitive instantiate and true unary generalize with empty original Gamma; it has no induction. Older geometry-only/legacy role protocols that say arithmetic lacks instantiate do not describe the new Q profile.
expressiveness_vs_evidence.inventory_transfer: The existing extraction sealed all27 roots from three donor certificates/two correlated sequents and two finite candidate families. It did not grant universal family validity or new-recipient/scientific inventory admission. Every later ground instance needs original-recipient primitive licensing, strict ordered dependencies and compatible exact point union.
expressiveness_vs_evidence.measurement: Numerical policy controls, a changed score, a legal proposal, more forced moves or fewer branches do not establish proof-search improvement. The same checked endpoint and complete total-cost comparison are required.

external_method_claims: None made. The ordinary symbolic comparator is a prospective internal equal-language/equal-library control, not a current product/tool performance assertion.

milestones.acceptance: First distinguish runtime feasibility from proof discovery. Any claimed solved target needs the complete declared independent word/current-point/source/resource checks. A contribution comparison requires paired endpoint-identical outcomes and measured inclusive cold costs; a lone GCTS proof is feasibility, not superiority.
milestones.deliverable: One genuine original Q canonical trial with complete accepted custody, actual call/event tape and all UNKNOWN reasons; independently check any naturally returned selected proof. Preserve deliberate-found rollback and fullboard separation.
milestones.fair_control: After this first unchanged trial, separately qualify an ordinary symbolic word-search comparator over exactly the same finite licensed recipes, parameters, original Gamma, dependency/height bounds and stopping/checking endpoint. Translate/check every returned word against the original literal current point relation; no proof route, stronger library, free checker postlude or fullboard-vs-word objective mismatch. The comparator is explicitly ordinary symbolic search, not a silently altered GCTS scheduler.
milestones.falsification: Setup/guard/serialization consumes the envelope and no qualified search/proof occurs; a pending target is mislabeled solved; or symbolic control obtains the same checked result more cheaply. UNKNOWN is not nonprovability and may expose an insensitive or unfitted benchmark rather than a theorem result.

milestones.GCTS_specific_ablation: Only after a separate complete soundness/emission/graph/rollback gate, compare original versus certified redundant rank-marked point models with identical primitive proof language and scheduler. Preserve both marking epochs. Rejection must arise from literal translated m-value agreement and full dependencies, not a rank callback/target-backcone predicate. No rank implementation or admission is supplied here.
milestones.acceptance: Every used donor-derived body and new ground instance independently expands to licensed primitives with strict prior/repeated receptor identity and whole current/fixed t/m agreement. Demonstrate actual family-dependent continuation effect and matched cold cost or accepted-target gain; separately report setup/mining/audit/grounding costs and unknown/unexecuted cases.
milestones.deliverable: Freeze a small new context/composition cohort BEFORE its compilation/proposals/search labels. Use new original-Gamma occurrence arrangements and a longer composition stratum for the two certificate-mined transport roles; name-renaming copies remain one correlation stratum. Current exposed I2 cases are integration/calibration cases, not newly held-out evidence.
milestones.fair_controls: Matched canonical point search, ordinary target-blind structural ordering, deterministic finite-family guidance and an equal-library ordinary symbolic reuse control. All consume the same audited candidate family schemes/current ground-instance checks and full primitive fallback. Use the SAME declared primary policy in every lane; actual selected proof and compatible unselected proposal counts remain separate. Do not compare a fullboard requirement in one lane to a short logical endpoint in another.
milestones.falsification: No eligible dependency-complete receptors; only pending marks are used; gains disappear when the symbolic control gets the same library; or literal-marking savings disappear after complete production/audit/serialization costs. These outcomes would support no GCTS-specific advantage, even if inventory reuse itself helps.
milestones.induction_boundary: Arithmetic induction/family transfer is a later separately compiled and licensed profile, not obtained by importing Incident templates or Q admission. It requires complete bounded schema/propositional/discharge alternatives, capture/freshness/full-context guards and capacity qualification, with no old associativity word as input.

milestones.acceptance: All donor state/feature/menu/RNG/reward/gradient/EMA/weight/rollback traces independently replay; resource-unknown or partial episodes do not train. Actual changed whole-family selections/continuations must occur, not merely score changes. Held-out targets use exactly the declared checker/current-point endpoint. Practical improvement requires additional checked targets at the matched resource budget, or lower full cost for the same solved set after discovery/training/replay charges.
milestones.concrete_policy: Reuse the reviewed mathV2 mixture/old-baseline/advantage-before-clipping semantics; the grounded small protocol specifies31 geometry structural features, epsilon0.1, temperature1, learning rate0.05 and EMA0.2. An eight-episode/four-donor/two-seed pilot is a reasonable prospective scale, with final qualified checkpoint only. Its real interface and endpoint/reward must be separately repinned: the old fullboard terminal reward cannot silently become a first-proof reward, and legacy four-role arithmetic features cannot silently be applied to Q unary tiles.
milestones.deferred: Autoregressive append/STOP/COMMIT of irregular primitive clusters changes the action grammar and needs a further distinct Source/primitive-expansion/rollback gate. Do not claim this from the finite selector.
milestones.deliverable: Use a separately admitted real-engine bridge to select explicit NULL or an exact validated single/pair family instance. The first restricted experiment learns whole-family utility; fixed pool membership/topology is not unrestricted learned construction or new lemma discovery.
milestones.fair_controls: Same family inventory/pool/NULL/validator/full fallback and scheduler under deterministic fixed utility, zero-weight uniform mixture, trained mixture, and ordinary equal-library symbolic reuse. Pair stochastic seeds and balance run order. No evaluation adaptation or favorable restart/seed selection.
milestones.falsification: Uniform/fixed/equal-library controls match or beat trained policy; only training contexts improve; incomplete audit prevents qualified weights; no actual action effect; or training/validation cost exceeds query savings. Rewarding pending outputs/duplicate rediscovery/macros invalidates the experiment rather than demonstrating RL.
milestones.freeze: Before any donor trajectories or recipient outcomes, freeze a NEW disjoint context/composition split, complete pools, structural features, seeds, reward, update rules and final-checkpoint selection. Historical mixed-context outcomes must not become fresh holdout. Formula/rule/library overlap is disclosed; renaming/context holdout is not unseen-theorem generalization.

summary: First earn a genuine fixed-model baseline. Then isolate certificate-mined inventory transfer and literal marking propagation from ordinary symbolic reuse. Only then measure incremental RL with the identical family pool and frozen donor-only updates.
